pages.title: Chica Eating Pizza Five Nights at Freddy's Printable Coloring Page
pages.description: Chica holds two slices of pepperoni pizza with melted cheese stretching toward her open beak in this printable coloring page. The character wears her signature bib around her neck while tiny hearts float near her head. Smooth line art and clear details make this page easy to fill using alcohol markers or colored pencils.
